About Vercel:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.
About the role:
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Platform team. You will build the observability systems that give Vercel visibility into how we build, ship, and operate our systems. Core Platform owns Vercel’s reliability, resilience, and engineering velocity. We’re looking for engineers to create observability for everything from cost attribution to deployment velocity, alongside the logs, metrics, and traces necessary to optimize how Vercel builds its systems. This is a role with a wide breadth where we quickly develop critical systems and improve the entire Vercel code base. You will report to Eric Larson, Engineering Manager, Platform and will be located onsite, hybrid, or remote.
If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.
What you will do:
Design and build high-scale, internal observability systems (metrics, logs, and traces) that give engineering and the business visibility into Vercel's own infrastructure.
Build cost attribution and chargeback tooling so spend can be accurately mapped to the parts of the business driving it, reducing reliance on third-party tools like Datadog.
Partner with Backend and Platform teams to instrument services for compliance, auditing, and record-keeping requirements.
Evaluate, integrate, and help operate observability infrastructure across our existing vendors and the CNCF ecosystem.
Ship pragmatic, high-leverage visibility quickly that drives improvement in how we build, deploy, and operate our systems.
Work closely with Backend and Platform engineers to scale observability infrastructure to the throughput and cardinality of Vercel's full production traffic.
About you:
Proficient in TypeScript, with backend/infrastructure experience.
Hands-on experience with Go, Rust, or Zig in production systems.
Experience with distributed computing systems at scale.
Experience with cloud infrastructure, including object storage.
Familiarity with observability tooling and concepts (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or CNCF-based stacks such as Prometheus-compatible backends).
Bonus if you:
Have contributed to or worked closely with CNCF observability projects.
Built, scaled, and improved internal developer platforms.
Benefits & Compensation:
Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.
The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000-$312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.
Disclosures:
Privacy: Please review our J ob Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
Equal Opportunity:  Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Our Summer Internship Program is designed for students entering their final year of university who are eager to gain meaningful, real-world experience in a fast paced, collaborative, and professional environment.

Your Role
As AI Engineering Intern for our Competitive Intelligence team, you will help the Competitive Intelligence team members design, develop, test, fine-tune, and manage AI chatbots, agents, and apps that help make the team’s processes more automated, scalable, and intelligent.
These AI tools will help the team:
Scale and accelerate market and competitive research
Accelerate competitive data analysis
Analyze and distribute competitive news with the appropriate stakeholders
Predict competitors’ next strategic moves
Automate the creation and upkeep of competitive Sales resources
Challenge our competitive resources to strengthen them before sharing them with users
Deliver contextual competitive insight to Sales teams at the right time and in the right format
Further automate the Competitive Intelligence helpdesk responses
This internship is not observational. As our AI Engineering Intern, you will design, build, and ship working AI-powered tools that will benefit 3,500+ Sales Representatives, support global Marketing campaigns, help refine key product roadmap decisions, keep our leadership informed of strategic market motions, and more. We will keep using your deliverables after the internship completion. You will also help us fine-tune existing AI tools.
By the end of your internship, you will have:
Delivered at least 1 functioning resource creation agent
Delivered 1 functioning resource challenging agent
Increased the Sales support AI agent’s response accuracy over 95%
Helped implement our Competitive Intelligence helpdesk v2
Designed the AI-powered technical comparison table builder v2
Delivered 1-2 other functioning projects that we defined together
Documented how to maintain the deliverables you delivered
In this role, you will work with our Competitive Intelligence team members, as well as key Competitive Intelligence stakeholders who use our competitive AI tools and competitive resources (Sales Representatives, Product Managers, Product Marketers, …).
Qualifications
Practical experience with Anthropic Claude Chat bots, Cowork projects, Code projects, and Design projects — not just coursework but actual hands-on Claude experience
Working knowledge of agentic/tool use patterns (function calling, RAG, basic orchestration) — doesn't need to be an expert, but shouldn't be learning what an agent is on day one
Exposure to evaluating LLM output quality — building a test set, scoring responses, and determining whether a prompt change helped
Exposure to version control basics, so work is recoverable and reviewable
Python proficiency; comfortable with API integration, data parsing, and basic pipeline construction
SQL exposure; able to read and modify a trivial transformation query
Ability to work with ambiguous, evolving requirements and iterate quickly on a 10-week clock — this is not a spec-handed-to-you internship
Comfortable interviewing subject-matter experts (analysts) to reverse-engineer a workflow before automating it
Rising Junior or Senior pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or a graduate student in an accredited college or university in AI engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field
Excellent written, verbal and communication skills
Willingness to learn about technology
Proficiency in Windows and Microsoft Office.
Ability to work independently with limited direction in a fast-paced environment; must be a high-energy, motivated self-starter
Understanding and operating within the team's competitive intelligence ethics policy (code of ethics to be shared during interviews)

Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.
   

  

 Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will develop innovative algorithms and strategies to facilitate robust grasping and manipulation in complex, real\-world manufacturing environments. You will be responsible for abstracting the inherent complexity of robotic manipulation into intuitive, seamless workflows. By building a software layer that possesses a deep understanding of manufacturing tasks, you enable users to transition from design to execution without needing deep subject matter expertise. Working alongside a diverse team of roboticists and application engineers, you will integrate and validate solutions across various industrial tasks and contribute to the launch of impactful robotics products.
   

  

 How your work moves the mission forward
   

  

* Design and implement robust and efficient production\-ready algorithms for robotic grasping and manipulation.
* Identify opportunities to apply cutting\-edge advancements in robotics and apply them to practical industrial problems.
* Transform complex partner requirements into highly reliable and functional technical outcomes.
* Improve our robotics software framework and contribute to a reliable product.


 Skills you will need to be successful
   

  

* Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field, with 5\+ years of experience in robotic manipulation.
* Strong foundation in linear algebra, spatial transformations, and rigid body dynamics.
* Hardware Experience: Direct experience testing and iterating on physical robots.
* 3 years of professional experience programming robotics software in C\+\+ and Python, with a proven track record of shipping production\-quality code.


 Skills that will differentiate your candidacy
   

  

* PhD in Robotics and Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, or a related field with a focus on robotic manipulation.
* ML Frameworks: Deep expertise with JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience in developing the entire stack: ranging from writing kinematics, motion generation, to system integration and testing.
